data.name: MetricBar_ShortExact
data.comment: One-word origin of a figure the program or Agent Studio measured, in the short line of the status bar.

data.name: MetricBar_ShortEstimated
data.comment: One-word origin of an estimated figure.

data.name: MetricBar_ShortNotExposed
data.comment: One-word origin of a figure the program does not give.

data.name: MetricBar_ShortMissing
data.comment: One-word origin of a figure that is not there.

data.name: MetricBar_SeenPrefix
data.comment: Start of the age text that the short line drops («vista hace 12 min» becomes «hace 12 min»). Keep the trailing space.

data.name: Terminal_Shell
data.comment: Accessible name of the list of shells of the terminal.

data.name: Terminal_Start
data.comment: Button that starts the terminal.

data.name: Terminal_Restart
data.comment: Button that starts the terminal again.

data.name: Terminal_Stop
data.comment: Button that stops the terminal.

data.name: Terminal_NotStarted
data.value: La terminal aún no está iniciada.
data.comment: Status line before the first start.

data.name: Terminal_Running
data.comment: Status line while a shell runs: {0} name of the shell, {1} process number.

data.name: Terminal_Stopped
data.comment: Status line after the person stops the shell: {0} name of the shell.

data.name: Terminal_ExitedWithCode
data.comment: Status line after the shell ends by itself: {0} name of the shell, {1} exit code.

data.name: Terminal_StartFailed
data.comment: Error when a shell does not start: {0} name of the shell, {1} the system message.

data.name: Terminal_Interrupted
data.value: La terminal se ha interrumpido. Motivo: {0}
data.comment: Error when the connection with the shell breaks: {0} the system message.

data.name: Terminal_WebViewMissing
data.value: Falta WebView2 Runtime, un componente de Microsoft. Instálalo para usar la terminal.
data.comment: Error when the viewer component is not installed.

data.name: Terminal_AssetsMissing
data.value: Faltan los archivos de xterm.js. Ejecuta tools\assets\fetch-xterm.ps1 y compila otra vez.
data.comment: Error when the terminal page is not in the build. Keep the script path.

data.name: Terminal_ViewerFailed
data.value: El visor de la terminal ha fallado. Reinicia la terminal o abre la aplicación otra vez.
data.comment: Error when the viewer process of the terminal dies.

data.name: Terminal_ViewerStartFailed
data.value: No se pudo iniciar el visor de la terminal. Motivo: {0}
data.comment: Error when the viewer does not start: {0} the system message.

data.name: Editor_MonacoMissing
data.value: El editor no está disponible: faltan los archivos de Monaco. Ejecuta tools/assets/fetch-monaco.ps1.
data.comment: Error when the editor library is not in the build. Keep the script path.

data.name: Editor_PageMissing
data.value: El editor no está disponible: falta Assets/editor/editor.html.
data.comment: Error when the editor page is not in the build. Keep the path.

data.name: Editor_WebViewStartFailed
data.value: El editor no está disponible: no se pudo iniciar WebView2. Motivo: {0}
data.comment: Error when the viewer does not start: {0} the system message.

data.name: Editor_PageFailed
data.value: El editor no está disponible. Motivo: {0}
data.comment: Error when the editor page reports a failure: {0} what the page said.

data.name: Editor_Crashed
data.value: El editor se ha detenido sin avisar porque ha fallado WebView2, el visor que lo muestra. Puede que se hayan perdido los cambios sin guardar de esta pestaña. Cierra la pestaña y abre el archivo otra vez.
data.comment: Error when the viewer process of the editor dies.

data.name: Editor_MixedLineEndings
data.value: Este archivo mezcla saltos de línea CRLF y LF. Al guardar, todos pasarán a {0}.
data.comment: Notice of the editor tab: {0} is CRLF or LF.
